reason: The exact independently reviewed v5 package was sealed before its first product comparison. That comparison found three authority defects: its lifecycle rule and two cases assigned audit-only to merely unavailable material even though ADR-0034 requires unresolved availability to abstain and permits audit-only only for deleted material; one missing-citation source case abstained instead of failing structural validation and being rejected; and several producer cases asserted applicability outcomes without neutral raw facts reachable through the accepted producer input seam. The product already followed the controlling unavailable/deleted rule, so no product change was made.
retention: The original oracle, provenance, and independent-review bytes remain immutable and audit-visible. This record changes only their current authority classification and records the missed authority conflict.
comparison_consequence: V5 cannot grant current validation authority. A materially independent successor must be authored and reviewed before product comparison.
